name: SDN-AP Propagator
description: General-perturbations propagation of whole catalogs: SGP4 and SGP4XP (the US Space Force SGP4-XP theory, clean-room), batch and structure-of-arrays, bounded memory, random access in time; an AP state is a function of its set and its time alone, whatever the order of requests or the sets flown between them (SPEC 9; test/set-caches.e2e.mjs); a store's AP sets keep their caches from one budgeted pool (cost and memory by request pattern: README, Memory and time; test/kernel-patterns.mjs).
